function timestamp() { 
	var response = document.getElementById("g-recaptcha-response"); 
	if (response == null || response.value.trim() == "") {
	  var captchas = document.getElementsByName("captcha_settings");
	  for(var x= 0; x < captchas.length; x++)   // comparison should be "<" not "<="
	  {
	  	var elems = JSON.parse(captchas[x].value);
		elems["ts"] = JSON.stringify(new Date().getTime());
		captchas[x].value = JSON.stringify(elems); 
      }
	
	} 
} setInterval(timestamp, 500); 

</script>

<section class="module padding-none table-row"><div class="block-table-half"> <div class="block-text article-image">
<div class="article-image-container" style="background: url('https://rainn.org/sites/default/files/Asset5norch.png') scroll no-repeat center center"></div>
<div class="article-content-container"><h2 class="color-blue"><a href="https://www.rainn.org/statistics">RAINN Statistics</a></h2>
<p class="text-margin">
										Every 73 seconds, an American is sexually assaulted. And every 9 minutes, that victim is a child.
									</p>
<a class="button-cta blue-light-border on-light" href="https://www.rainn.org/statistics">Learn More</a>
</div>
</div><div class="block-table-half"> <div class="block-text article-image">
<div class="article-image-container" style="background: url('https://rainn.org/sites/default/files/rainnnews.png') scroll no-repeat center center"></div>
<div class="article-content-container"><h2 class="color-blue"><a href="https://www.rainn.org/news">Latest News</a></h2>
<p class="text-margin">
										Get the latest news on the work RAINN is doing every day to end sexual violence.
									</p>
<a class="button-cta blue-light-border on-light" href="https://www.rainn.org/news">Learn More</a>
</div>
</div></div></div></section><section class="module padding-none table-row"><div class="block-table-half"> <div class="block-text article-image">
<div class="article-image-container" style="background: url('https://rainn.org/sites/default/files/preventionnav.png') scroll no-repeat center center"></div>
<div class="article-content-container"><h2 class="color-blue"><a href="https://preventionnavigator.rainn.org/">Prevention Navigator</a></h2>
<p class="text-margin">
										Prevention education is not one-size-fits-all. The Prevention Navigator helps colleges find the right program and gives students and administrators a place to share their experiences.
									</p>
<a class="button-cta blue-light-border on-light" href="https://preventionnavigator.rainn.org/">Learn More</a>
</div>
</div><div class="block-table-half"> <div class="block-text article-image">
<div class="article-image-container" style="background: url('https://rainn.org/sites/default/files/Screen Shot 2019-10-03 at 4.11.30 PM.png') scroll no-repeat center center"></div>
<div class="article-content-container"><h2 class="color-blue"><a href="https://www.rainn.org/survivor-stories">Survivor Stories</a></h2>
<p class="text-margin">
										Hear from courageous survivors about what it means to tell their story and be believed, and the many paths they take to continue healing after sexual violence.
									</p>
<a class="button-cta blue-light-border on-light" href="https://www.rainn.org/survivor-stories">Learn More</a>
</div>
</div></div></div></section>
</div>

<section class="module padding-none clearfix featured-news">
<div class="module-head">
<h4 class="color-gray-dark"><a href="#">RAINN News</a></h4>
</div>
<div class="table-row no-margin-top" style="margin-top: 0">
<div class="block-table-third">
<div class="block-text cta-readmore-bottom">
<h3>
<a href="/node/3597">How to Support Someone Who is Experiencing Domestic Violence </a>
</h3>
<p>
										It can be hard to know how to help a loved one who is experiencing domestic violence or intimate partner violence. That’s why during domestic violence awareness month this October, RAINN is focusing on sharing information for those who suspect someone in their life might need this support.
									</p>
<a class="link-readmore" href="/node/3597">
								 				Learn More								 			</a>
</div>
</div>
<div class="block-table-third">
<div class="block-text cta-readmore-bottom">
<h3>
<a href="/node/3601">You Left Your Job Because of Sexual Harassment. What Now? </a>
</h3>
<p>
										Some victims of workplace sexual harassment are reluctant to report what happened because they fear the effect on their career. For those who leave their job after experiencing harassment or assault, it can be hard to know how to approach a new job search, application, or interview process.
									</p>
<a class="link-readmore" href="/node/3601">
								 				Learn More								 			</a>
</div>
</div>
<div class="block-table-third">
<div class="block-text cta-readmore-bottom">
<h3>
<a href="/node/3600">When Sexual Assault is in the News, Survivors Turn to RAINN</a>
</h3>
<p>
										When high profile sexual assault cases are in the news, thousands of survivors and their loved ones contact RAINN’s National Sexual Assault Hotline. For some, this is the first time they are sharing their story. For others, the support specialists on the hotline are the only people in their lives who they know will listen and believe them.
									</p>
<a class="link-readmore" href="/node/3600">
								 				Learn More								 			</a>
</div>
</div>
</div> </section>
</div>
</div></div></div><div class="field field-name-field-cta-blocks field-type-node-reference field-label-hidden"><div class="field-items"><div class="field-item even"><div class="three-columns-grid">

<a class="button-cta white-border" href="https://rainn.org/articles/warning-signs-young-children">Read More</a>
</div></div><div class="block-table-third"><div class="block-stats smaller cta-block"><h2 class="color-blue">Every 73 seconds, another American is sexually assaulted.</h2>
<a class="button-cta blue-border" href="https://rainn.org/statistics">More Stats</a></div></div><div class="block-table-third"><div class="block-fundraiser smaller cta-block"><h2 class="color-white">95¢ of every $1 goes to helping survivors and preventing sexual violence.</h2>
